eligibility_table_note: Legacy Grants.gov applicant eligibility categories; descriptions cross-checked against socialreel/grants.py and repository fixtures where available. Numeric mapping is provisional: needs check against Grants.gov docs. No live documentation or API verification performed.

eligibility_codes.06: Public and State controlled institutions of higher education
eligibility_codes.11: Native American tribal organizations (other than Federally recognized tribal governments)
eligibility_codes.12: Nonprofits having a 501(c)(3) status with the IRS, other than institutions of higher education
eligibility_codes.13: Nonprofits that do not have a 501(c)(3) status with the IRS, other than institutions of higher education
eligibility_codes.22: For profit organizations other than small businesses
eligibility_codes.25: Others (see text field entitled "Additional Information on Eligibility" for clarification)
eligibility_codes.99: Unrestricted (i.e., open to any type of entity above), subject to any clarification in text field entitled "Additional Information on Eligibility"
